title: Omega-3 fatty acids reprogram tumor-associated macrophage cytokine signaling and suppress pancreatic cancer growth.
publicationName: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America
journalName: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America
snippet: Dietary polyunsaturated fatty acids (PUFAs) shape inflammatory signaling within the pancreatic tumor microenvironment (TME), but the cellular mechanisms underlying their effects on tumor progression remain unclear.
